description:
Amazon WorkSpaces plays nice with everyone. Access your personal Windows environment on Android, iOS, Fire, Mac, PC, Chromebook, and Linux devices.


- [Windows] Reduced the time it takes to connect to your WorkSpace in the new client experience.
- [Windows] The new client experience now remembers the display and window state, size, and position of your last session, restoring them the next time you connect.
- [Windows] Added an option in the new client experience to download and install the USB redirection driver from within the session when it's not already installed.
- [Windows] Added an option in the new client experience to copy details for USB devices that are not yet allowed, making it easier to share these with your administrator.
- [Windows] The new client experience now uses the language selected in the classic client to improve the switching experience.
- [Windows] Improved the smoothness of the loading animation shown before the session starts in the new client experience.
- [Windows] Fixed issues in the new client experience that could prevent signing in, including a WebView2 initialization error.
- [Windows] Fixed an issue in the new client experience that prevented screenshots and screen sharing from working properly in certain conditions, such as during a Microsoft Teams meeting.
- [Windows] Fixed an issue in the new client experience that rendered the full screen options for all or selected displays unavailable after reconnecting with a different display setup.
- [Windows] Fixed an issue in the new client experience that caused empty translucent windows to briefly appear before the session loaded.
- [Windows] Fixed an issue in the new client experience where WorkSpace details displayed the protocol incorrectly as UDP for a TCP connection.
- [Windows] Updated the DCV SDK.
- [Windows] Additional bug fixes and enhancements.
